title: setSensorZoomRate
description: Starts, updates, or stops continuous runtime zoom-rate control for a zoom-capable sensor. Zero rate stops the active lease and freezes current zoom.

type.description: Command discriminator. Use canonical 'setSensorZoomRate' in newly generated commands.

observer.description: Observatory/site name that owns the target actuator or sensor.

sensor.description: Sensor or payload name. Omit to use the observatory primary sensor where the command allows it.

zoomRateLevelPerSec.description: Normalized zoom level change per second. Positive values zoom in; negative values zoom out.
